runtime.submissionStats: admin form.submission.stats reports submission totals, status aggregates and per-form aggregates without changing public submit or processing flow
runtime.notificationStatus: admin can mark local form notification rows read or unread with readTime metadata
runtime.notificationStats: admin form.notification.stats reports local notification read/unread counts and event aggregates without external delivery
runtime.notificationStatsUi: ability page renders local notification totals and event aggregates as tables, while retaining raw JSON for diagnostics
runtime.submissionStatsUi: ability page renders submission totals, status aggregates and per-form aggregates as tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.submissionExportUi: ability page renders submission export as bounded summary and preview rows while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.notificationReplay: admin form.notification.replay creates a new local notification row from an existing notification without external delivery
runtime.designerPreviewUi: ability page previews fields[] from schemaJson, flags empty or duplicated field names, and lets operators select a field to refill the designer inputs without server writes
runtime.requestLimit: public submit and admin save/delete/status reject request bodies beyond maxRequestBytes before JSON parse
runtime.statusValidation: form.save normalizes definition status to enabled(1)/disabled(0), form.submission.status accepts only 0/1/2, and form.notification.status accepts only 0/1
runtime.accessIntegration: public submit rejects unreadable content-bound forms when content.access is enabled
runtime.submissionFilters: admin submission list accepts optional formId/contentId/status filters with bound SQL and maxListRows limit
runtime.notificationFilters: admin notification list accepts optional formId/contentId/status/event filters with bound SQL and maxListRows limit
